name: 33021 · Hollywood, FL
findings: ZIP 33021 (Hollywood) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33021 (Hollywood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
